newsitem.title: USA: CellStar to sell Communications Centers.
newsitem.headline: CellStar to sell Communications Centers.

text.p: CellStar Corp said Thursday it will sell its Communications Center retail business conducted inside Wal-Mart Stores Inc's Sam's Club locations across the country to MCI Communications Corp.
CellStar said the 335 full-service Communications Centers would be sold for an undisclosed amount in a transaction scheduled to close by the end of November.
CellStar said it will also sign a distribution agreement to supply MCI with cellular phones and accessories for the Communications Center retail operations.
The company said it will use proceeds from the sale to reduce bank debt and for general working capital purposes.
